Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 5 minutes Total time: 20 minutes Number of Servings: 3 Ingredients 1 can (5 ounces) tuna in water, drained 1/4 cup chopped celery (about 1 stalk) 1 green onion, sliced 1/2 cup grated carrot 1 Tablespoon mayonnaise 1/4 teaspoon pepper 3 whole-wheat English muffins 1/2 cup (2 ounces) grated cheddar cheese Directions Wash hands in soap and water. In a small bowl, mix tuna, celery, onion, carrot, mayonnaise and pepper. Top each muffin half with tuna mixture and grated cheese. Broil until cheese melts, about 3 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: No tuna? Use canned or cooked salmon or mackerel.
